first_lines: Transthoracic echocardiogram performed on presentation. Apical 2 chamber view, at end diastole (left) and end systolic (right) demonstrating left ventricular apical hypokinesis
Coronary angiography, with the left coronary artery (left) and the right coronary artery (right) demonstrating non-obstructive coronary artery disease.

limitations: Text and table cells from anydoc Inline.text (literal runs); Markdown output not used

review.content_class_rationale: Word file with two supplementary figure captions (apical 2 chamber echocardiogram; coronary angiography) and two embedded still images, one per caption; all text units read and both images viewed.

ownership_evidence.quote: Echocardiogram after transfer revealed a large area of left ventricular apical hypokinesis, moderate atrial dilatation, and tricuspid regurgitation in the context of the known complete heart block (Figure 2 and supplementary figure 1).
The coronary angiogram revealed nonobstructive coronary artery disease, with a focal 50% stenosis in the midleft circumflex coronary artery (supplemental figure 2).

estimated_counts.basis: Two embedded images (word/media/image1.png and image2.png) counted in the document package.

review.notes: Echocardiogram image shows scanner overlay text; no printed clinical values are transcribed here.
limitations: Left/right view assignment follows the caption text, not the pixels; stills cannot show wall motion.
Text and table cells from anydoc Inline.text (literal runs); Markdown output not used

review.content_class_rationale: Slide deck (PPTX) file holding four embedded MP4 clips (three echocardiogram clips and one left ventriculogram clip) with four poster images; the text units are only the labels Video 1 to Video 4.

ownership_evidence.quote: Echocardiogram after transfer revealed a large area of left ventricular apical hypokinesis, moderate atrial dilatation, and tricuspid regurgitation in the context of the known complete heart block (Figure 2 and supplementary figure 1).
The left ventriculogram performed revealed near normalisation of the apical hypokinesis and an elevated end diastolic pressure of 20 mmHg (Figure 3).

estimated_counts.basis: Sum of ffprobe frame counts (39, 63, 41, 128) and durations (1.30, 1.26, 1.37, 8.53 s) of the four embedded MP4 parts.

review.notes: Three echocardiogram clips show scanner overlay text including a name-like line (category only, not copied); the fourth is a greyscale ventriculogram clip with a catheter line.
limitations: Frames sampled every 0.333 s across the full length of each of the four clips (4, 4, 4 and 26 full-resolution frames, 38 in total) and all viewed, plus the four full-resolution poster images; frames between samples, continuous motion and audio were not reviewed.
The container is a PPTX; the same sampled frames are also reviewed in the supp-2 document sidecar (embedded_videos).
Reviewer-completed after opening both cached files and viewing all embedded images and sampled video frames.
